dedupe_keys.name: climaaxkorsou phase 2 foundation spatial data for curacao climate risk assessment

description: The Meteorological Department Curaçao publishes foundation spatial data for its CLIMAAXKorsou climate-risk assessment. Zenodo supplies a ten-metre elevation raster and an archive of exposure inputs free under CC BY 4.0. A GeoPackage contains 315 census neighbourhoods plus fifty-one gap zones, with population and demographic fields from the 2023 census. The archive also describes Caribbean sea-level projections and FEWS discharge values for seven rainfall intensities. These inputs support coastal, pluvial, heat and drought risk simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Curaçao foundation package. Coverage is national, with gap zones carrying no settlement data. The discharge CSV lacks grid-cell geometry, which must be obtained separately; it cannot be spatially joined from the file alone. Cited third-party inputs retain their own terms and uncertainty. No raster or archive was downloaded or risk map produced.
